questions.q: What does Keltner argue is the main source of authentic power?
questions.why: He says power is a reward from others for being helpful.

questions.q: How do older siblings typically gain power over younger ones, according to the book?
questions.why: Older siblings have more knowledge, leading to natural authority.

questions.q: What tendency do upper‑class individuals show regarding their success, per Keltner?
questions.why: They see themselves as more capable and credit hard work.

questions.q: What negative health effect can prolonged powerlessness cause?
questions.why: Powerlessness linked to social disadvantage harms health.

questions.q: Which historical example does Keltner use to illustrate perceived forceful power?
questions.why: He cites the Spanish taking Native lands as forceful power.
